tasks.query: Review this candidate SKILL.md and tell me if it's good enough to promote into a shared skill library.
expected_behavior: Structures the audit cheap->expensive (Tier 0 through Tier 4) rather than an ad-hoc list
Assigns per-dimension scores (percentage of applicable max, corpus ~52% reference) and a grade band
Flags the description as a workflow-summary + first-person routing failure, not merely 'unclear'
Names the 'spawn a subagent ... let it figure out the details' line as a subagent-prompt/contract failure (no prompt/scope/return)
Flags curl|bash and allowed-tools:* as reachable security/contract failures
Flags the Slack-posting responsibility as scope creep (unrelated to RAG) and recommends a split
Flags the prose chunk-size validation as something that should be a script/contract, not prose
Produces a verdict plus a COMPLETE, UNRANKED inventory of suggested improvements — no top-N, no ordering by leverage/effort, no 'do this first'
States each finding's concrete consequence (what actually happens) rather than a vague risk
